# Metadata save

This owner preserves the public `save_metadata` signature and JSON schema, then delegates sidecar publication to the atomic writer.

Owner này giữ public signature `save_metadata` và schema JSON, sau đó giao publish sidecar cho atomic writer.

Nearest schema/publication case is in `test/save.rs`; filesystem publication details live in `../atomic_publish/`.

Test schema/publication gần nhất nằm ở `test/save.rs`; chi tiết publish filesystem nằm trong `../atomic_publish/`.
